section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Summary Strip
title: A completed work order adds nothing to the three Remaining-side figures
refs: SV-8661 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 4a S4a-N2 - a completed work order never contributes to Remaining Work, Work Orders Not Started, or Remaining Work on Open Work Orders, because those figures read the two Approved tabs only (S5-R4, S5-R6); Story 4a was raised by SV-9119 and carries no Jira story key of its own, so the owning story is Story 5 / SV-8661, which specifies those three figures)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Earned and Remaining columns are turned on in the Work In Progress report.
3. A ZZAUTOTEST work order exists with approved labor and parts that have only been partly performed, so its row shows a Remaining above $0.00, and its status is In Progress so it is listed in the "Approved - partially completed" tab.
4. A second ZZAUTOTEST work order exists that is approved but has had no work done on it at all, so it is listed in the "Approved - not started" tab.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Write down the summary strip figures Remaining Work, Work Orders Not Started, Remaining Work on Open Work Orders and Work Orders Ready to Invoice.
3. Select the "Approved - partially completed" tab, find the first seeded work order and write down its Remaining value.
4. Open that work order and set its status to Complete.
5. Go back to the Work In Progress report and reload it.
6. Read the same four summary strip figures again.
7. Select the "Completed" tab and confirm the completed work order is listed there.
8. Repeat steps 3 to 6 for the second seeded work order, the one that had no work done on it.
expected:
1. After the first work order is completed, Remaining Work has gone down by exactly the Remaining that work order's row used to show, and it does not include any part of that work order any more.
2. Remaining Work on Open Work Orders has gone down by exactly the same amount, and it does not include any part of the completed work order any more.
3. Work Orders Not Started is unchanged by completing that work order.
4. Work Orders Ready to Invoice has gone up, so the money moved rather than disappeared.
5. After the second work order is completed, Work Orders Not Started has gone down by exactly the value that work order used to contribute, and neither Remaining Work on Open Work Orders nor Work Orders Ready to Invoice counts anything of it as Remaining.
6. In both cases the completed work order contributes $0.00 to Remaining Work, $0.00 to Work Orders Not Started and $0.00 to Remaining Work on Open Work Orders.
7. Those three figures read the two "Approved" tabs only, so a work order sitting in the "Completed" tab can never appear in any of them.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 4a, S4a-N2, which points at Story 5, S5-R4 and S5-R6), read on 28 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its summary-strip story SV-8661. Story 4a was raised by SV-9119 and carries no Jira story key of its own.
